name: Nihari
description: A slow-cooked mutton stew with rich, spicy gravy, a Pakistani delicacy.
instructions: Fry onions in ghee until golden, add mutton and nihari masala.
Cook with yogurt on low heat for 4-5 hours.
Garnish with ginger, serve with naan.

name: Paya
description: A flavorful trotter soup with aromatic spices.
instructions: Boil paya with spices and onion for 4-5 hours.
Add oil and adjust seasoning, serve hot with naan.

name: Chicken Karahi
description: A spicy chicken curry cooked in a traditional karahi.
instructions: Heat oil, add ginger-garlic paste and tomatoes.
Add chicken and spices, cook until oil separates.
Garnish with green chilies, serve with roti.

name: Mutton Korma
description: A creamy mutton curry with a blend of spices.
instructions: Fry onions until golden, add mutton and spices.
Cook with yogurt until tender, garnish with almonds.
Serve with naan or rice.

name: Keema Matar
description: Minced meat cooked with peas and spices.
instructions: Cook minced meat with tomatoes and spices.
Add peas, simmer until soft.
Serve with paratha or rice.

name: Rogan Josh
description: A rich mutton curry with Kashmiri spices.
instructions: Marinate mutton with yogurt and spices.
Cook with fried onions and cardamom until tender.
Serve with rice.

name: Chicken Handi
description: A creamy chicken dish cooked in a handi.
instructions: Cook chicken with tomatoes and spices in oil.
Add cream and butter, simmer until thick.
Serve with naan.

name: Saag Gosht
description: Mutton cooked with spinach for a nutritious dinner.
instructions: Cook mutton with spices until tender.
Add blended spinach, simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve with roti.

name: Beef Qorma
description: A flavorful beef curry with rich gravy.
instructions: Fry onions, add beef and spices.
Cook with yogurt until tender, garnish with cashews.
Serve with naan.

name: Dal Gosht
description: A hearty combination of lentils and mutton.
instructions: Cook mutton and lentils with tomatoes and spices.
Simmer until well combined, serve with rice.
